score_convention: higher = more likely fake; label 1 = spoof / fake

sampling.spoof_sampling: spread evenly over the attacks of the split

clip_score: pellav2: mean of the window probabilities; pellav2_max: highest window; lcnn: calibrated probability
lcnn_verdict_rule: LCNN spoof probability p: authentic if p < 0.4170, flagged (AI-generated) if p >= 0.5770, inconclusive otherwise; heuristic signals carry no weight

latency_seconds_per_clip.note: pellav2 forward pass incl. preprocessing, file decoding excluded
